title: Player Chat Filter
description: Player Chat Filter is a lightweight Minecraft mod designed to reduce chat distractions in competitive environments like TierList events and Crystal PvP fights. It allows players to focus by filtering chat and showing only relevant messages.
body:
**Player Chat Filter**

Player Chat Filter is a lightweight utility mod designed for competitive Minecraft environments such as TierList events and Crystal PvP fights. It helps players maintain focus by filtering out unnecessary chat messages and displaying only relevant information.

### Features

* Use `/chatfilter <player>` to show only messages from a selected player along with server messages.
* All other player chat messages are temporarily hidden.
* Easily disable filtering with `/chatfilteroff`.
* Designed for high-focus scenarios like PvP fights and TierList sessions.
* Minimal performance impact and simple to use.

### Use Cases

This mod is especially useful for:

* Crystal PvP duels and tournaments
* TierList evaluations
* Any situation where chat distraction affects performance

By reducing chat noise, Player Chat Filter allows players to concentrate fully on gameplay and critical communication.
